
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tcjiaan/p/23513239" title="发布于 2026-11-01 18:41">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【ASP.NET Core】让 EF Core 生成更“合理”的 UPDATE 语句</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>相信 .NET 玩家都知道，EF Core 自动产生 SQL 更新语句是通过跟踪实体状态实现的。不过，在 Web 中是无状态的，查询出一个东东返回到前台，然后用户要更新数据，POST 过来就是修改后的数据。</p>
<p>比较笨的方法是先根据主键查询出数据，然后把客户端 POST 过来的数据赋值，这样就有新旧值的比较了，EF Core 也能生成准确的 SET 子句了。这种方法虽然笨但很简单，它有个缺点：在更新前你会多跑一轮查询。</p>
<p>本文咱们就用这个实体来演示。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Student
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? Major { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DemoDbContext : DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DemoDbContext(DbContextOptions&lt;DemoDbContext&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> opt)
        : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(opt)
    {

    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DbSet&lt;Student&gt; Students { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Student&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            ent.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_students</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始数据</span>
            ent.HasData(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Student { Id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">吴小车</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Major = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">挖矿</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Student { Id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">李肺</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Major = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">攻城掠地</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Student { Id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">赵逗逗</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Major = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">打磨芯片</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Student { Id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>, Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">范统</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Major = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">悲观经济学</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Student { Id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>, Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">贾仁亿</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Major = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">社会猪圈学</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
        });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>Major 属性表示某同学选的专业。</p>
<p>这时候你会想到官方文档有介绍过的 ExecuteUpdate 方法。它不需要查询，可以直接发送 UPDATE 语句。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>_ = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> dbcontext.Students.ExecuteUpdateAsync(setter =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    setter.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">SetProperty(stu </span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> stu.Name, newStu.Name)</span>;
    setter.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">SetProperty(stu </span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> stu.Major, newStu.Major)</span>;
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>上述方法虽然避免了查询，但没有新旧值的比较，你不知道用户更改了哪些属性，只能全部 SET 一遍。其实，这种把所有字段都 SET 一遍的做法还更简单的操作——直接把实体状态变为 Modified 就完事了，EF Core 也会生成完整的 SET 子句。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;IActionResult&gt; UpdateStudent(Student stu<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">, string old</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
 {
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> dbcontext = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService&lt;DemoDbContext&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 开始跟踪</span>
     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">dbcontext.Students.Attach(stu)</span></strong>;
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 强行改变实体状态</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">     dbcontext.Students.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><strong>Update(stu)</strong></span>;

     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提交更新</span>
     _ = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dbcontext.SaveChangesAsync();
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> RedirectToAction(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Index</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
 }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>以前老周告诉过大伙伴：EF Core 从实体查询出来的时候开始跟踪。那是指正常情况，不正常情况下可以调用一下 Attach 方法。这个方法的功能就是把一个实体实例手动添加到 EF Core 的跟踪列表中，并且将实体状态设置为 Unchanged，即未更改。</p>
<p>随后，调用 Update 方法，会将实体状态变为 Modified，当然，EF Core 仍然不知道哪些属性被修改了，所以，除主键以外，其他属性都变为 Modified。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202611/367389-20261101181132461-1450550870.png" alt="屏幕截图 2026-11-01 181042" width="340" height="234" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202611/367389-20261101181203641-1608424086.png" alt="image" width="312" height="193" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;EF Core 生成的 SQL 语句如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">UPDATE</span> "tb_students" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SET</span> "Major" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p0</span>, "Name" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p1</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> "Id" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      RETURNING </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>尽管咱们没修改 Name 属性，但由于 EF Core 无法比较判断，所以连同 Name 属性也设置了。</p>
<p>那有没有办法让 EF Core 知道哪些属性被修改过呢？有的，EF Core 不仅允咱们改实体状态，也允许咱们手动设置旧值（快照值）和新值（当前值）。不过咱们要解决 HTTP 无状态的问题，即 HTTP 一轮请求后是不留痕迹的。因此，在用户请求数据时，在返回客户端时为实体对象做一个备份，用户编辑完了，连同备份的旧值一起 POST 回服务器，这样就能做比较了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">@model DB.Student

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="modal-dialog"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> method</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="post"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> asp-action</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="@nameof(HomeController.UpdateStudent)"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="hidden"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> asp-for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Id"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">@{</span>
            // 把旧的值序列为 JSON
            <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">string json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model);</span></strong>
    <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">}
</span></span>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="hidden"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="old"</span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="@json"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="modal-content"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="modal-header"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">h5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>编辑学生信息<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">h5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="button"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="btn-close"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> data-bs-dismiss</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="modal"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="modal-body"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="row mb-3"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">label </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="form-label"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> asp-for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Name"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>姓名：<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">label</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="text"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="form-control"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> asp-for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Name"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="row mb-3"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">label </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="form-label"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> asp-for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Major"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>专业：<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">label</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="form-control"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="text"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> asp-for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Major"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="modal-footer"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="button"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> data-bs-dismiss</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="modal"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="btn btn-secondary"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>取消<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="submit"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="btn btn-primary"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>确定<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在 form 中，咱们只要用一个隐藏字段保存旧的数据（JSON）就行，然后在接收 POST 的 action 方法中加上名为 old 的字符串参数。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;IActionResult&gt; UpdateStudent(Student stu, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> old)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> dbcontext = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService&lt;DemoDbContext&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 开始跟踪</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    dbcontext.Students.Attach(stu);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entry =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dbcontext.Students.Entry(stu);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 反序列化</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> oldvals = JsonSerializer.Deserialize&lt;Student&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(old);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重点：设置快照</span>
    entry.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">OriginalValues.SetValues(oldvals!</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提交更新</span>
    _ = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dbcontext.SaveChangesAsync();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> RedirectToAction(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Index</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>全场最重要的就是&nbsp;OriginalValues.SetValues 这句，就是把原来备份的数据作为快照，它就能跟新的值比较了。</p>
<p>上面代码其实可以精简，Attach 方法本身就返回 Entry 的，所以</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 开始跟踪</span>
<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entry =</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> dbcontext.Students.Attach(stu)</span></strong>;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 反序列化</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> oldvals = JsonSerializer.Deserialize&lt;Student&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(old);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重点：设置快照</span>
entry.OriginalValues.SetValues(oldvals!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">……</span></pre>
</div>
<p>再来看看效果。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202611/367389-20261101182617767-2072049473.png" alt="image" width="273" height="184" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>现在，咱们只改变了学生的专业名称。然后提交。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202611/367389-20261101182734308-846311473.png" alt="image" width="303" height="182" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>看看 EF Core 生成的 SQL 语句。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">UPDATE</span> "tb_students" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SET</span> "Major" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p0</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> "Id" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      RETURNING </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>由于现在它能识别到只有 Major 属性的值改变了，所以 SET 子句只更新这个属性。</p>
<p>这样解决是不是很舒服？不会丧失 EF Core 自动生成 SQL 的功能，又不用自己拼装 SQL 语句。</p>
<p>这次分享的内容比较简单，所以就到这里了。至于大伙伴可能疑惑老周又跑去干什么大项目了，这么久没写文章了。想多了，大项目不会找老周这种乡下码农的，人家肯定找那些满屋子放满证书的靓仔。</p>
<p>最近是搞了个 Stm32 的小项目，也没多复杂，只用了 9 天时间。主要是前期去他们工厂跟他们吵了四五天，最后才确定方案。而且 Boss 还想用 500 块钱打发的态度，还没脑子的瞎指挥（这货就是啥也不懂还乐于装 X 那种）。还是人家厂里的经理（应该是经理）懂事，项目能搞成这小伙子的功劳不小，两边讲道理。老周一开始就给 boss 放下狠话的，你要是几百块能打发的你自己用 AI 做，不必去找人来干；只要你找到我给做，我可以按你们的需求做，但你得按我的思路来，不要在那里瞎叫喝。你去打听打听，我当年刚大学毕业，面试就敢硬刚 HR，把 HR 怼到辞职的。你，还排不上号。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
